When do I collect or receive the games, and when do they go back?
Equipment is delivered or collected the day before your function and returned or collected the day after, so there's no pressure on the day itself.
Every hire carries a refundable deposit equal to the hire price. It's refunded directly into your bank account once the equipment has been returned and inspected in good condition.
What do you need from me to release the equipment?
A copy of the responsible person's ID and a signed indemnity form. We'll send the form when you book.
R200 within Pretoria, R300 within Johannesburg and R500 to surrounding areas. Collection is free, and couriering is available on request at standard courier rates.
Can I hire a single game, or only packages?
Either. Every game is available on its own from R150. Packages bundle several games at a lower combined price and include a free custom WhatsApp invitation.
A set number of Big, Medium and Small games of your choice from the catalogue, plus a custom-designed WhatsApp invitation to match your event theme. See the four options above.
